pkgmetadata.longdescription: Gaze provides facial authentication for Linux using on-device face recognition. It includes a system daemon (gazed), a CLI client, PAM modules for login and unlock integration, an optional GTK4 and Adwaita GUI, and a GNOME Shell extension for GDM lock-screen unlock.

use.flag: Install the GNOME Shell extension for GDM face authentication
Build the GTK4 and Adwaita GUI for enrollment and configuration
